title: Simplified Chinese Mod Translations
description: A collection of Simplified Chinese translations for multiple mods. Currently includes Xaero's World Map, Zoomify, and Do a Barrel Roll. More to come!
body:
# English：
**Mods Simplified Chinese Translation Pack**

This resource pack provides complete Simplified Chinese translations for the following mods:

- **Xaero's World Map** — 295 entries fully translated
- **Zoomify** — Replaces incomplete official translation
- **Do a Barrel Roll** — Includes advanced expression documentation
- **Faster Elytras** — Full translation of all settings and commands

---

## Features

- Complete translation of all text, no untranslated English remaining
- Unified terminology, consistent with Minecraft player conventions
- Covers settings UI, right-click menus, HUD, keybindings, server configuration, and advanced expression documentation
- Loaded as a resource pack, does not modify original mod files
- Compatible with vanilla and other resource packs

---

## Installation

1. Download this resource pack (`.zip` file)
2. Place it into the `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` folder
3. Launch the game, go to Options → Resource Packs
4. Move this resource pack to the right "Selected" list, ensuring it has priority over other translation packs
5. Click "Done" and it will take effect

---

## Notes

- This is a community-made translation, **not an official version**
- Does not include Xaero's Minimap (that mod already has official built-in Chinese)
- If you encounter untranslated text or have suggestions, leave feedback in the comments

---

## Supported Versions
See the "Game Versions" list on the right side of this page. Each version of this resource pack is packaged separately for different Minecraft version ranges. Download the one that matches your game version.


### ⚠️ Version Notes
Language file structures may differ between major Minecraft versions. This resource pack is primarily optimized for current mainstream versions (1.21.x, 1.20.x, 1.19.x). If you encounter any untranslated text on older versions (1.19.2 and below), it may be due to key name differences. Please report it, and I will address it in future updates.
---

## Related Mods

- [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)
- [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)
- [Do a Barrel Roll](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll)

---

## Update Plans

- More mod translations may be added in the future
- Maintained alongside mod version updates


# 中文:

# 简体中文汉化合集

## 📖 简介
本资源包为以下三款模组提供完整的简体中文汉化，替换官方不完整或缺失的中文翻译：

- **Xaero's World Map** — 世界地图（295 条完整汉化）
- **Zoomify** — 自由缩放（替换官方不完整汉化）
- **Do a Barrel Roll** — 鞘翅飞行增强（含高级表达式文档翻译）
- **Faster Elytras** — 更快的鞘翅（完整汉化所有设置与指令）

---

## ✨ 特点
- ✅ 全部文本完整汉化，无英文残留
- ✅ 术语前后统一，符合 Minecraft 玩家习惯
- ✅ 覆盖设置界面、右键菜单、HUD、按键绑定、服务器配置、高级表达式文档
- ✅ 资源包形式加载，不修改模组原文件
- ✅ 可与原版及其他资源包共存

---

## 📥 安装方法
1. 下载本资源包（`.zip` 文件）
2. 放入 `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` 文件夹
3. 启动游戏，进入 选项 → 资源包
4. 将本资源包移至右侧“已选”列表，确保优先级高于其他汉化包
5. 点击“完成”，即可生效

---

## ⚠️ 注意事项
- 本资源包为社区个人汉化，**非官方版本**
- 不包含 Xaero's Minimap 的汉化（该模组已有官方自带中文）
- 如遇未汉化文本或翻译建议，欢迎在评论区反馈

---

## ✅ 适用版本
请查看本页面右侧的“游戏版本”列表。本资源包按 Minecraft 版本段分别打包，请下载与你游戏版本对应的包。


### ⚠️ 版本说明
不同 Minecraft 大版本之间的语言文件结构可能存在差异，本资源包优先适配当前主流版本（1.21.x、1.20.x、1.19.x）。旧版本（1.19.2 及以下）如果出现部分文本未汉化，可能是键名差异导致，请反馈，我会在后续版本中补充。
